decision_basis.126: Upstream explicitly owns normal game installation and requests distribution only through its official channels; missing published v1.0.3 digest blocks managed authentication, not already permitted-copy attachment. CWD game root and portable/external/mod profiles explicit.
decision_basis.1121: Official offline ready package exists; public source establishes in-process preparation and host paths, but SDK/capture/profile scope and potential external updater ownership favor bounded upstream-owned prepared attachment; no private SDK access or speculative Xbox capability needed.
decision_basis.144: Existing working-copy attachment avoids adopting runtime native overlay/compiler trust and mutable toolchain ownership; full package/upstream preparation retained, no universal PS1 campaign.
decision_basis.158: Public title lifecycle plus static native entry identified; customized backend paths are unknown. Prepared copy retains actual external SDK/profile roots; no asserted default, SDK backup, private access or full containment certification.
decision_basis.1846: Technically ready package/user data layout but operative recovered-game/SDK permission condition persists; conditional useful guide only, no managed admission or issue closure.
decision_basis.343: Existing package-texture provenance condition unchanged; no new guide bypass.
decision_basis.128: Withdrawn original assets and attributable source/use mapping still unresolved; preserve exact acquisition restriction.
